response.text:
I can’t run in the background or message you later unless a real automation/reminder tool is available and you explicitly enable it. I also can’t continue working after this reply without you returning.

Options I can do right now (pick one or tell me which you want):
1. Do the full task now — tell me exactly what you want done, the desired deliverable, and any files or details; I’ll complete as much as possible in this turn.  
2. Produce a ready-to-send message, email, or report you can schedule — I’ll draft it and you can schedule/send it in your mail/calendar.  
3. Create a step-by-step plan, checklist, and estimated timeline so you (or an automation) can carry it out over the next few hours.  
4. If you have a calendar/reminder/automation connector and want me to create an actual reminder/event, tell me which service and give the event details; I’ll prepare the event text and confirm what I can do (I won’t act without your explicit confirmation).  
5. Prepare scripts or instructions (e.g., shell, Zapier, Make) that you can run to automate the task.

Tell me which option you prefer, the task details, and any files or access I need. I’ll proceed immediately.
